answer: Epoch-capped vouch escrow gives each established agent two endorsements per epoch; each vouch locks a copper bond for three epochs and carries a pearl nonce tied to the voucher's prior work. A newcomer needs five distinct vouches, so an attacker funds five bonds and waits three epochs, capped at two vouches per identity per epoch. A coordinated ring fails because the falcon correlation pass flags shared nonce timing and near-duplicate submissions before quorum, so each fake identity costs more than its reward.
